Contains the Shawnee Backpack Trail (40+ mi, includes Buckeye Trail and North Country Trail segments), 60+ miles of bridle trails, mountain bike trails, and numerous day hiking trails.

Hiking Trails present (see trail_parents). Horseback riding and dispersed camping permitted throughout the forest. Horsemen's campground: 20-site facility near Bear Lake.
